text:
tara (Docs): Quick sync: product decided to alias embed-small -> embed-lite on v2 and rename the metadata param from user_metadata -> user_info in the SDK. Need migration note, tiny snippets, and a customer verification checklist.

ben (SDK): Thanks. Is embed-small fully removed or aliased?

rosa (ML): It'll be aliased on v2 to embed-lite (same vectors) for clarity. We'll remove the old alias after 60 days, so we need a docs-friendly migration path.

ben (SDK): Plan: keep both model ids accepted in SDK, but change examples to embed-lite. Also rename param in new major/minor? Prefer a minor with deprecation shim: keep user_metadata but map to user_info and emit a DeprecationWarning in Python and console.warn in JS. PR: sdk#9012.

ash (Support): We've seen a handful of tickets where customers hardcode model id strings. Please add a short KB note for search & replace and a regex we can send.

qa-bot: Suggested tests: (1) call embeddings with model=embed-lite -> returns 128-dim vector, (2) call with model=embed-small -> accepted and returns same vector shape + `Warning` header, (3) pass `user_metadata` -> accepted and SDK emits deprecation warning.

tara (Docs): Can someone paste 2-line snippets we can drop into migration guide? Keep them minimal.

ben (SDK): JS snippet: `// old
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-small', input: ['a'] , user_metadata: { foo: 'bar' } })
// new
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-lite', input: ['a'], user_info: { foo: 'bar' } })`

ben (SDK): Python snippet: `# old
client.embeddings.create(model='embed-small', input=['a'], user_metadata={'foo':'bar'})
# new
client.embeddings.create(model='embed-lite', input=['a'], user_info={'foo':'bar'})`

tara (Docs): Also include raw HTTP example and exact warning header string so support can grep logs.

tara (Docs): HTTP example: `POST /v2/embeddings` with header `Content-Type: application/json` and body `{ "model": "embed-lite", "input": ["..."], "user_info": {"team": "ai"} }`.

tara (Docs): Warning header when legacy model id or param used: `Warning: 299 - "embed-small and user_metadata are deprecated; use embed-lite and user_info"`. Quote verbatim.

rosa (ML): Confirmed vectors identical; we'll publish a short benchmark note to reassure customers.

ash (Support): I'll draft KB with a small sed command to replace ids: `sed -i "s/embed-small/embed-lite/g"` and param rename examples.

ben (SDK): I'll include a changelog entry and ensure the SDK tests assert the deprecation warning. PR #9012 will reference docs PR #9013.

tara (Docs): Action items: ben open SDK PR and include snippets, rosa publish benchmark blurb, ash draft KB, me update migration guide and add "how to verify" steps. Target: merge before alias removal (60 days).

ben (SDK): Aiming to open the PR within 48h.

tara (Docs): Thanks all — I'll open the docs PR and tag reviewers. Ping here if wording changes.
